mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_monthly_snapshot (snapshot_month, total_value, avg_daily_cost) VALUES (#{snapshotMonth}, #{totalValue}, #{avgDailyCost}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_value = VALUES(total_value), avg_daily_cost = VALUES(avg_daily_cost), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_month, total_value, avg_daily_cost FROM dashboard_monthly_snapshot ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC LIMIT 12
